articles.title: Jio IPO’s GMP rises to 22% as India’s largest ever issue set to open on October 21. Should you subscribe?
articles.summary: The Jio IPO, India's largest-ever, opens tomorrow with a price band of Rs 1,065–1,119. Strong market demand is reflected in a 22% grey market premium.
articles.explain: The 'grey market premium' (GMP) is the difference between the price a stock is expected to trade at when it hits the stock market and its IPO offer price. While not officially regulated, it is often used by investors as an informal indicator of potential listing day gains.

articles.title: Korea’s KOSPI crashes another 5% as AI rout deepens; AI bellwether down over 40% from peak
articles.summary: The South Korean KOSPI index dropped another 5% as the sell-off in AI-related stocks intensified. Major industry players like SK Hynix and Samsung have seen significant valuation declines.
articles.explain: A 'market rout' refers to a rapid and significant drop in asset prices across a specific sector or index. In this case, the AI-focused 'bellwether' stocks—companies that act as indicators of the health of their sector—are declining as investors worry that the initial hype surrounding AI may not translate into immediate, sustained profits.

story.title: Global AI Sector Sell-off
story.so_far: Global tech markets have recently faced volatility as investor enthusiasm for AI-related infrastructure and chip manufacturing cools. Companies that saw massive growth during the AI boom are now struggling with market corrections and reassessments of their long-term earnings potential.

timeline.text: South Korean tech stocks experienced sharp declines, with major AI suppliers SK Hynix and Samsung falling heavily amid a broader sector rout.

articles.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
articles.summary: The U.S. government has expanded its restrictions on the AI model DeepSeek, banning its use within all civilian federal agency IT systems due to national security concerns.
articles.explain: This move is part of the ongoing 'tech cold war' between the U.S. and China. By banning the software in civilian agencies, the U.S. is attempting to mitigate the risk of data exfiltration or foreign surveillance via AI models that may have backdoors or security vulnerabilities.

story.title: US Restrictions on DeepSeek AI
story.so_far: DeepSeek is an artificial intelligence platform originating from China. U.S. officials have expressed concerns that the software could be utilized to compromise sensitive federal data, leading to a systematic policy of restricting its presence in government information technology infrastructure.

timeline.text: U.S. civilian agencies are now officially prohibited from using DeepSeek, broadening existing defense-sector bans.

articles.title: Up 64% in 6 months already; should you still buy Neogen Chemicals? Antique sees 23% upside potential - Check target
articles.summary: Antique Stock Broking has initiated coverage on Neogen Chemicals with a 'Buy' rating, projecting 23% upside potential based on its growth in the battery chemicals sector.
articles.explain: Initiating coverage means a brokerage firm has started providing regular analysis and investment advice on a stock. A 'buy rating' with a target price indicates the analysts believe the stock is undervalued and likely to increase in price over the specified period (usually 12 months) based on fundamental growth.

story.title: Neogen Chemicals Market Analysis
story.so_far: Neogen Chemicals produces specialty organic chemicals and inorganic chemicals for various industries, including pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals. It has been gaining attention recently as investors look for companies that can benefit from the global shift toward electric vehicle battery manufacturing and supply chain diversification away from China.

timeline.text: Brokerage firm Antique initiated a buy recommendation, citing the company's expansion into battery chemistry and non-Chinese supply chain opportunities.
